stem: After mapping a canopy, the center is consistently much brighter than the perimeter. Before increasing total fixture output, what should the grower evaluate?
choices: Whether the nutrient label can equalize photons
Whether a single center reading can replace the grid
Whether fixture position, spacing, optics, and canopy geometry can improve distribution
rationale: Distribution problems should be diagnosed from the spatial map. Raising total output without correcting geometry can intensify already-bright zones while edge zones remain relatively dim.
